name: street-interview
label: Street interview / vox pop (Daniel Mac, Subway Takes)
description: One fixed recurring question in 0-2 s, persistent top title bar with the question/take, natural ambience, answer as the payoff, host reaction.

sync.broll: rare detail inserts on the reveal (0.5-1 s); ~95:5
sync.fillers: punch-in on the surprising answer, host reaction insert
sync.music: none; natural street/train sound carries it
sync.transitions: hard cuts only; the title bar persists (hook_text dur = whole video)

evidence: est. from public sources; calibrate with measured references
compliance_lock: signed releases from everyone on camera
health: no patient vox pops about results
